prompt: A lone middle-aged dock worker in a canvas work jacket waits beside an iron bollard on a freight dock at 2 a.m., seen small from a low three-quarter angle across wet concrete, his face in shadow. Gantry cranes rise against a dark sky behind stacks of plain shipping containers. One white floodlight from the upper right throws long hard shadows across the dock, and the harbor water is black. Semi-realistic painted graphic-novel comic art with heavy dark ink linework, diagonal hatching in the shadows and crosshatching in the deepest shadows, realistic painted shading and muted desaturated colour. An ordinary present-day American city. Every sign, screen and surface is blank and plain.
